newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares practically unchanged, volume low.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares practically unchanged, volume low.

text.p: Leading Russian shares closed practically unchanged on Monday in thin volume, brokers said.
The Russian Trading System index of 21 shares rose by 0.42 points to 175.97 on $7.61 million in volume.
"Some prices are a bit higher, some prices are a bit lower than Friday's closing ones," said Andrei Galperin, a trader from Creditanstalt-Grant.
He said volumes and activity on the market decreased in afternoon trade.

"The morning activity must have been an echo of the end of last week, when traders fulfilled leftover orders," he said. "Now investors and brokers are only getting ready for trading, evaluating prices."
Investors focused on leading shares, such as UES, Mosenergo, Surgutneftegaz, Rostelekom and Irkutskenergo, said Boris Shvedsky, a broker from IK Aton.
He said Irkutskenergo and Surgutneftegaz had risen on news about their planned American Depositary Receipts issues.
Irkutskenergo said last week it planned to issue level one ADRs later this year.
Irkutskenergo closed at $0.105/$0.107 after $0.104/$0.108 at Friday's close.
Last month U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission gave Surgutneftegaz permission to proceed with an application to issue ADRs. It plans to issue ADRs by the end of the year.
"Prices are now heavily dependent on political information," Shvedsky said. "But I think they will rise smoothly until the end of October."
Galperin said the current situation on the market may persist for at least the upcoming week.
Mosenergo rose to $0.974/$0.977 from $0.963/$0.970, UES was traded at $0.0781/$0.0790 after $0.0781/$0.0788, Rostelekom was $2.52/$2.55 after $2.52/$2.59 and LUKoil was $9.35/$9.49 after $9.30/$9.49.
